author: EmeraldBlocman
quote: If i could rate this gave more than a 10 i would. i love this game, even more than OOT. This game is what defines a game with an amazing storyline that involves. Emotions, grief, acceptance, death and all the above. Every character has a certain issue they are dealing with, nobody feels like a random NPC. they all have meaning to their own story and even some collide through story quest to obtain certain mask at certain times of the 3 day cycle. This game is beyond amazing and i am patiently waiting for the remake. <3

quote: This game isn't what the hype was living up to be. Honestly this is a perfect home simulator game, i bought 2 copies incase i wasn't able to get one for PlayStation and i can easily say i refunded this. Sorry rockstar but this game is not all that.

author: EmeraldBlocman
quote: I was too young to put a review when i first played this game, i was able to play it again along with the Remake recently. But this old classic is such an amazing piece of gaming that is special in my heart. During its release i experience my first time ever 3D gaming, Open world and dungeon bosses to this extent. As i am older now i feel its only right to review the most important game of my life. Thank you Nintendo for this classic GEM

author: EmeraldBlocman
quote: Im a big fan of the GTA series and i think 6 is OK but I'm very disappointed in how my expectations were not met. Beyond the extremely slow pace on building the relationship on the first arc lots of the gameplay felt wonky especially the horrendous 30 FPS. People should try this game out for themselves and judge it then. for me its a no.
